in_sanskrit.name: Enyansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva's emblem
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Enyansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Enyansh is a name derived from Sanskrit, and it holds a deep connection to Lord Shiva. The name is believed to represent Lord Shiva's emblem, the trident, which symbolizes creation, preservation, and destruction.
